title: SR-1.06 One licence schema, validated everywhere
request: Closes G06: LICENSE_FIELDS omits trial, org and trial_ext that other modules read; installLicense skips the check activate applies. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: none.

tasks.title: Schema and both entry points
requirements: every field read anywhere is in the schema
install and activate run the same validator
the header comment matches what a licence may carry

installLicense refuses a licence carrying name, email or machine exactly as activateLicense does, and writes no file; the test installs such a licence from file and asserts the refusal (the twin measured install writing a licence that activate refuses: src/cli/licensing.mjs:148-151 never calls extraFields, :90 does)
a trial licence and an org licence install from file and activate by key under the same rule; the schema header states which non-identity fields (trial, org, trial_ext) a licence may carry

the schema check lives in verifyLicense, so install, activate, loadLicense and every reader apply one rule; the trial rules (one trial per organisation, a trial never replaces a live paid licence) live in one function that install and activate both call

the relay default that the activation server sends beside the licence (the wrapper's relay object) is the one unsigned exception: the schema lists it as a wrapper field; it is typed and validated (default_url a relay://host:port address exactly as src/cli/relay.mjs accepts it, default_domain a domain name, nothing else); it is applied only when no relay is configured; a malformed value is ignored with a warning and activation still succeeds; docs state that it is unsigned; every field read from the licence itself is a signed schema field
a trial licence must carry org, so the one-trial-per-organisation rule cannot be sidestepped by leaving org out; existing fixtures that build a trial without org gain one
keys that name Object.prototype members (__proto__, constructor, toString) are unknown fields, and an org of that name never reaches a prototype through the trial record

each red-green criterion of this task that runs test/license-schema.test.mjs has its own subtest whose name starts with <task>-cNN: (NN is the criterion's position in this task, so T1-c01: for the first), and the criterion runs only that subtest
